5.description: [Pending Restart + Clear Cache] All currently available Stones of Retreat had their descriptions updated to reflect their use correcly.  You are now able to add opposite faction stones to your Vanity Collection, Faction restriction for using the spell still apply same as before. Also now you can add stones to your Vanity collection that would otherwise require different Expansion to be available, example now you can add TBC stone for future use to your collection while Vanilla is current expansion. And lastly "Sanctum of the Stars" (The Scryers) and "Altar of Sha'tar" (The Aldor) now indicate and are useable if you are not Hostile to said faction (Guards attack = not have good time).
